decisions.reason: The aloe vera line still has a dedicated page and sits close to the core facial range, and in small-batch production it costs little to keep, so it is worth holding the option open while its value becomes clearer.

After two years the serum is only mentioned on the website, which weakens its signal, but it is cheap to keep and the evidence does not yet show its value is unlikely to be realized, so it stays one more period.
The cleansing oil launched in 2024 and has partly taken over the cleansing slot left by the dropped cleansing milk, so its prospects are still uncertain and it is cheap to keep while results come in.
